title: TR-HASH MoE 200M full SFT versus OPT-125M base: practical assistant prompt panel
scope: A narrow qualitative smoke test, not a matched architecture benchmark.

protocol.scoring: Manual semantic scoring. A pass requires the expected fact to appear before later drift; verbosity is not independently penalized.

limitations: OPT-125M is a base language model; TR-HASH is full-parameter instruction-SFT.
Parameter count, architecture, data, tokenizer and prompt wrapper are not matched.
One sample per prompt cannot estimate a stable capability rate.
The panel does not isolate the effect of deterministic routing.
